newsitem.title: UK: NZ Sport, RUGBY UNION - Samoa finishes tour in triumph.
newsitem.headline: NZ Sport, RUGBY UNION - Samoa finishes tour in triumph.

text.p: A superb first-half hat-trick of tries by left-winger Vaimosa Fa'Aofa helped Western Samoa round off their 11-match tour of Britain in winning fashion at Richmond on Tuesday.
Richmond scored first with a try from Jim Fallon in the seventh minute and led 12-7 after 20 minutes, but the Samoans then turned on the style.
Fa'Aofa notched the first of his tries from a neat break by outside-half Earl Va'a. Va'a kicked the conversion, but missed three of his other five kicks at goal.
Simon Mason showed him the way by converting his own try to put Richmond 12-7 up after 20 minutes.
It was all downhill for the London club from then on as Va'a kicked a penalty before Fa'Aofa scooted over for two tries in the three minutes leading up to halftime.
The smooth-running Samoans added two more tries in the second half, centre Terry Fanolua and right wing Afato So'Oalo crossing in the 42nd and 58th minutes respectively to complete a 32-12 win.
